about: The crop–origin registry (Supply outlook foundation, E151): one entry per crop the platform models. life_cycle is the crop's biology — alternate bearing (perennial fruit and nut trees and vines: a heavy crop drains the tree, the next is light) decides whether the bearing cycle is removed before a calibration; annual crops are only detrended. A crop's origins are not listed here: they are every country FAOSTAT reports production for (data/reference/faostat_crops.json). A crop not in this registry is refused, never guessed. eurostat_crop is the crop's code in Eurostat apro_cpsh1 (EU-27, EFTA, UK, candidate countries); where a source's definition differs from FAO's it is stated in eurostat_label, never silently mixed. fas_commodity is the crop's USDA FAS PSD commodity code; fas_label states where FAS's definition differs from FAO's (milled rice, oils, shelled almonds). nass_production and nass_area are the crop's exact USDA NASS Quick Stats series (short_desc) for the US and its states; nass_label states where NASS's definition differs from FAO's (canola only, wine grapes only, bearing acres), nass_gap why a crop is not read from NASS. eurostat_regional lists the Eurostat crop codes read by NUTS-2 region (apro_cpshr), summed where Eurostat publishes the crop's total only nationally — wheat by region is common wheat and spelt (C1110) + durum wheat (C1120), the two parts of C1100 in Eurostat's crop classification; eurostat_regional_gap why a crop has no regional series — series from different sources are never mixed.
provenance: life cycles carried from ml/features/crop_cycle.ALTERNATE_BEARING_CROPS (2026-08-16, the finding that removing a spurious cycle from annual crops strips real climate variance)

crops.fas_label: Almonds, SHELLED basis — FAO reports in shell
crops.nass_gap: not read from NASS: its in-shell series mixes scales (2018–2022 published as 1,897.5 'TONS', 2023 as 2,015,000) and its shelled series is another definition than FAO's in-shell
crops.eurostat_regional_gap: not published by NUTS-2 region in apro_cpshr (the crop code is not in the dataset)

crops.nass_production: SUGARCANE, SUGAR & SEED - PRODUCTION, MEASURED IN TONS
crops.nass_label: sugarcane for sugar and seed — cane for other uses not included

crops.note: FAO's own aggregate (item 1804, 'Citrus Fruit, Total') — FAO's figure, not a sum of ours; its components (oranges, tangerines, lemons and limes, grapefruit, other citrus) are FAO items 490, 495, 497, 507, 512

crops.fas_label: Coffee, Green (60 kg bags → tonnes) — as FAO

crops.gap: FAOSTAT does not report durum separately from wheat — held as a named gap

crops.nass_label: NASS's durum class of spring wheat

crops.nass_label: corn for grain (silage is a separate series, not read)

crops.eurostat_label: Olives for oil — narrower than FAO's 'Olives' (which includes table olives)
crops.fas_label: Oil, Olive — the OIL; FAO reports olives
crops.nass_label: all olives (fruit, as FAO's 'Olives'); area = bearing acres
crops.eurostat_regional_gap: not published by NUTS-2 region in apro_cpshr (the crop code is not in the dataset)

crops.fas_label: Oil, Palm — the OIL; FAO reports oil palm fruit

crops.nass_label: canola only — NASS reports rapeseed as a separate series, not read (FAO's item includes both)

crops.fas_label: Rice, MILLED basis — FAO reports paddy

crops.nass_production: SORGHUM, GRAIN - PRODUCTION, MEASURED IN BU
